new_company._screen: The create-company screen (/companies/new): name, the company URL (proposed from the name, checked live), default language, the person's own name when they have none, and Create / Cancel.
new_company.name_required: Shown under the company name when it is empty or not valid; tells what to write.
new_company.url: Label of the slug field; the text must contain 'URL'.
new_company.available: Shown under the URL when it is free; the app may append the full address after it.
new_company.unavailable: Shown under the URL when another company has it. Do not say which.
new_company.reserved: The URL is a word the product keeps for itself.
new_company.invalid_format: The URL has characters or a length we do not accept.
new_company.language_hint: Short help under the language field.
new_company.your_name: Asked only when the account has no name yet.

company_home._screen: The first screen inside a company: a welcome with the company name.
company_home.welcome: {{name}} is the company name, rendered as plain text.

not_found._screen: Shown when the company address does not exist or the person is not a member. Must not reveal which of the two it is.
not_found.title: Heading of the not-found state.
not_found.body: One sentence; covers both cases without saying which.
not_found.back: The one action of the not-found state: a link to the start screen.

errors._screen: Error messages of creating a company and of opening one, shown under the field or on the screen. One per error code the API returns. Short, say what happened and what to do next; never blame the person.
errors.invalid_request: Generic failure of the creation request.
errors.idempotency_mismatch: The same attempt was reused with other data; asking to try again is enough.
errors.too_many_creations: Rate limit on creating companies; do not give the limit or the wait time.
